description: An open-source e-commerce platform built on WordPress that allows users to build and manage online stores.
auth_notes: Uses Consumer Key and Consumer Secret via HTTP Basic Authentication or query parameters.
credential_notes: WooCommerce is open-source and self-hosted; developers generate API keys directly inside their own store's admin dashboard for free.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering products, orders, customers, coupons, and more via WordPress/WooCommerce endpoints.
mcp_notes: No official vendor-published MCP server found; community options or internal evaluation folders exist in code.
rationale: WooCommerce provides a fully documented, robust REST API and self-generated API keys on self-hosted instances, allowing immediate agent integration.

evidence.note: Describes using Basic Auth with consumer key and consumer secret.
Explains how to generate REST API keys inside WooCommerce settings.
Provides the complete technical reference for WooCommerce REST API endpoints.
